title: SC strikes down unfair provisions in seafarers magna carta

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Supreme Court has struck down as unconstitutional provisions of the Magna Carta of Filipino Seafarers requiring workers to post a bond pending resolution of labor cases, as well as restricting legal remedies they may avail of, as they violate due process.
